subject: Trouble with setting up dynamic filters on dataframe.

messages.author: 8bddaa2a946149a0
messages.subject: Trouble with setting up dynamic filters on dataframe.
parts:
Hi,

I am trying to implement the following functionality in my app:
  • Provide filters on data frame that are dependent on each other. For example, I have taken mtcars dataset and filters on that are mpg, cyl, disp and gear. If cyl 6 is selected then the dataframe is subset and based on the subset dataframe other filters' choice list will get update. Please find the gist for code below, it is also attached.
https://gist.github.com/anonymous/8dc26efcfa8b75ed0498dc9526b0d842
 
The problem I am facing is, everytime I run the app, the filters get rendered twice in the beginning. In my logic I am first checking if the inputs are null, if yes then I kept still selected to default value "--Select--", then update the choice list to column values. But it renders the filters the second time, may be because the inputs are now initialized to "--Select--". 
Could any please check and let me know if there is any way to stop it from rendering the inputs twice. I tried to use UpdateselectizeInput with a slightly different logic, but it seems to break the app. Any insights or suggestions are highly appreciable. 

Thanks,
Sushmitha
